title: Inline Date-Arithmetic Envy (Introduce Foreign Method)
pattern: Client code performs manual field extraction and arithmetic on a library struct because the library type lacks a cohesive helper method.
why_bad: It clutters client code with low-level details of a foreign class's fields (like boundary conditions for months/years). If month rollovers are handled incorrectly, it introduces bugs across different client call sites.
detection: Client code calling multiple getters on a foreign library type to compute a slightly modified instance of that same type.
counterexample: Ordinary construction or serialization of a date structure from an external data source.
